rationale:
Independent judgment: PROCEED. The change is a correctly bounded, additive process exception that raises the global lifetime scientific batch cap from 60 to exactly 64 for the four already-granted item4 slots, plus a safe recovery of the never-admitted author14 call under the operator's new GPU-smoke staging input.

Correctness of the cap exception: autonomy_accounting.reserve_scientific now reads the limit from limits.scientific_batch_allowance instead of the hardcoded constant; the default hook returns {'limit':60} (verified in source and test_other_runs_keep_default60). The 64 override (item4_scoped_calls.batch_allowance) installs only when batch_extension is not None and run==RUN, and it recomputes item4_batch_recovery.granted against batch_approval=v['review_sha256'] — the genuine independent APPROVE of THIS change (change_id item4-batch-continuation-20261009), enforced in install_item4_scientific_revision.install (AUTHOR_INSTALL_GENUINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED) and component.verified(). The override additionally pins all 60 original global rows, requires len(tail)<4 and len(rows)==60+len(tail) with the exact expected call sequence, so it can never reach a 65th call and cannot alter any original row. test_exact_four_slots_count_all60_and_never65 exercises this through real local/global reservation and confirms batch_limit==64, 60 originals byte-identical, run-cap 26 and batch-cap 64 both enforced, and a 5th call in every stage refused.

No protection weakened: the HALT, daily-50, run-cap, duplicate/UNCERTAIN/RUNNING and uncertain-reservation refusals in reserve_scientific are untouched (only the batch-limit comparison was refactored). test_refusals_do_not_create_author14_or_charge covers 8 fault classes (row tamper, extra row, daily, halt, pending, duplicate, early-interpretation, direct-global) with zero accounting change. test_without_extension_real_batch60_refuses confirms the 60 cap still bites absent the extension.

Recovery safety: item4_batch_recovery.restore writes no scientific row, performs 0 model/provider calls, requires the exact BLOCKED/AUTONOMY_BATCH_CALL_LIMIT refusal state, preserves the original 429-file workspace, pins and manual_account, uses a separate CAS-guarded replacement workspace, and is non-replayable (ALREADY_RECOVERED, STATE_RACE). 18 parametrized fault tests (including symlink and parent-path-alias) all refuse while preserving 22 calls and state. Admission of author14 still occurs later through the ordinary reserve path (local 23 / global 61 only after a real model step). The held R41 grant and the author14 response approval are authenticated independently of the new implementation approval (held_response_approval / held_*_continuation_approval), as the brief requires.

Authority/money: the authority_sha256 throughout is a7fbba4b… (the overnight-autonomy operator decision that explicitly delegates one-use process-limit exceptions to Claude within an approved item), and the GPU-smoke staging decision is hash-bound (STAGING_SHA 12457759…) and surfaced verbatim to author/reviewer without substituting for scientific review. This patch commits no new dollars; the $75 item4 smoke cap is already operator-approved, so no money escalation is owed. No scientific finding is closed by this administrative change, and the two interpretation slots retain the ordinary complete-execution verifier rather than early-smoke acceptance.

No secrets or privacy regressions: the only secret-like strings are synthetic fixtures in refusal tests; modal execution passes secrets=[]. Tests (327 passed) and the batch-fix regression (27 passed) are consistent. The change is proportionate and does not add infrastructure-to-prove-infrastructure overhead; it is the shortest safe path to the next result. No unresolved findings, so I approve.
